chunks: From him, from Abī Jaʿfar, from Abī al-Jawzāʾ, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUlwān, from ʿAmr ibn Khālid, from Zayd ibn ʿAlī, from his forefathers, from ʿAlī عليه السلام, who said:

There is no qisas between men and women except in the case of life; and there is no qisas between free persons and slaves except in the case of life, intentionally; and there is no qisas among children in anything except in the case of life.

key_terms.النَّفْسِ: life; the case of homicide or killing

ai.seo_question: When does qisas apply between men and women, free persons and slaves, and children in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning qisas in cases involving men and women, free persons and slaves, and children. It limits qisas between these categories to cases involving the taking of life, with intentionality specified in the case of free persons and slaves.
